report_title: # P0044 ARC12 Separator-Arrow-Guided Panel-Stamp Mixed-Partition Transfer-40 Packet
claim_boundary: P0044 is a source-pinned, failure-inclusive fresh transfer measurement of P0043's unchanged generic vocabulary on a globally task-ID-disjoint filename-only mixed-partition cohort: 20 ARC-AGI-1 evaluation-split tasks plus 20 ARC-AGI-2 training-split tasks. The P0044 cohort was committed at e7ebc90561aadd4d06b1225c610ef7b48ec98678 before any selected task grid was parsed, visualized, scored, or used for operator design; its static disjointness test was then committed at fcf43614cae99c151e325da5f1c7461912636efe. The controller bytes are exactly P0043's feff068b8e1e1116427f87f59af4e54b922a1dd1 freeze, including `separator_arrow_guided_panel_stamp`; no post-P0043 operator, parameter, source, or policy change participates. This is fresh evidence only within the explicitly mixed-partition internal protocol, remains non-comparable to all-training transfer, and cannot support a benchmark-submission claim. The live controller receives only visible demonstrations and test input before committing a complete grid. It receives no task ID, cohort metadata, GT feature contract, GT solver, historical decomposition, or held-out output. Every NO remains in the denominator. P0044 cannot retune this frozen controller; any later R&D must use a separately frozen, globally disjoint cohort.

prior_protocol_reference.comparison_boundary: P0043 is an exposed same-cohort development result. P0044 has a globally disjoint roster and can supply fresh task-level transfer evidence for the frozen P0043 vocabulary only; it is neither a same-cohort numerical delta nor a benchmark score.

operator_transfer_gate.required_for_task_level_reuse: At least one P0044 exact post-answer solve must select separator_arrow_guided_panel_stamp with training compatibility true and no fallback.
operator_transfer_gate.negative_outcome_rule: If no P0044 exact solve selects separator_arrow_guided_panel_stamp, retain the complete failure-inclusive record as negative transfer evidence and do not promote the relation.
operator_transfer_gate.architecture_boundary: The relation dynamically derives all roles and accepts only the strict unique divider/template/arrow/payload/destination structure. It has no task-ID, fixed-color, GT, source-path, cohort-metadata, or held-out-output path.

offline_diagnostic_provenance.role: P0044 measures the P0043 frozen generic vocabulary without importing, parsing, calling, or passing through GT feature records or GT solver code. The P0044 roster was selected by filename metadata only; its held-out outputs appear only after the live controller commits complete predictions.

synthetic_contract.coverage: The unchanged frozen contract derives dynamic backgrounds, separator colors, template/payload colors, role vertical positions, lower anchor positions, payload masks, and both arrow directions from visible demonstrations; it rejects duplicate arrows, mismatched templates, blocked destinations, multiple dividers, and contradictory visible outputs.

visual_contract.coverage: The frozen renderer keeps ARC black and magenta distinct, preserves compact labels for structural operators, and labels this relation as an arrow-guided panel stamp; each measured task emits a native SVG corpus-callosum trace.
